change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The driver torque response time limit is tightened from 100 ms to 80 ms. This requires re-evaluation of all tests that measure torque response time, as previous evidence may no longer meet the new limit. Test procedures and scripts must be updated to reflect the new threshold.

A new 80 ms latency requirement is added for emergency brake commands. This requires re-evaluation of all tests that measure brake command latency, as previous evidence may not include timing data or may not meet the new limit. Test procedures must be updated to include latency measurement.

assessments.reason: The test verifies the driver torque response time which is directly altered by the tightening of the limit from 100 ms to 80 ms. The previous evidence of 94 ms no longer meets the new 80 ms requirement, and the test script still references the old 100 ms threshold.

Requirement VCU-DR-01 limit tightened from 100 ms to 80 ms
assessments.recommended_action: Update the test script threshold to 80 ms and rerun the test to generate new evidence.
